capabilities: Push vault files and folders to IMA knowledge bases or personal notes
Pull IMA knowledge base notes and file attachments into the vault
Generate sync-difference and cleanup reports (old versions, duplicates, deleted items)
Schedule automatic daily push and pull runs at set times
Download note images locally or inline local images as base64 on push
disambiguation: Not a general cross-device vault sync; it only syncs content between the vault and the IMA service.
extras: Desktop-only (isDesktopOnly: true). Unofficial third-party plugin with no affiliation to Tencent/IMA. Because IMA's write API only supports creation, changed files are pushed as new @vN versions and deletions are handled by moving entries to a recycle-bin folder in the knowledge base rather than deleting them. Credentials are stored in Obsidian's secret storage, with plaintext fallback below version 1.11.4.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to exchange notes with IMA, and IMA's write API lacks update and delete operations, making reliable syncing hard.

relations.evidence: 把 Obsidian 里的文件/文件夹推送到 IMA 知识库或个人笔记

summary: Two-way sync plugin that pushes Obsidian files and folders to IMA knowledge bases or personal notes and pulls IMA content back into the vault.
